headline: DR Congo Relocates Over 20,000 Artisanal Miners From Kolwezi Mine
summary: Authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo have started relocating over 20,000 artisanal miners from the Kamilombe site in Kolwezi under an agreement reached in late October.
why: Kolwezi is the heart of the world's cobalt and copper belt; clearing artisanal diggers often precedes formal industrial concessions and commercial development.

impacts.name: Cobalt
impacts.why: The relocation alters informal output flows from one of the major cobalt-producing regions in the DRC.
